Requirement: App shall be responsive mobile-first with desktop enhancements
App shall meet WCAG 2.1 AA for color contrast and keyboard navigation
App shall publish Privacy Policy and Terms of Use and DMCA or Notice and Takedown documents at launch
App shall provide a Report Abuse entry point on any public page
Users shall be able to create an account with email and password
Users shall be able to log in or out and maintain sessions securely with HTTP-only cookies and CSRF protection
Users shall be able to add recipes manually via a guided multi-step form including title description ingredients steps tags and image
Users shall be able to import a recipe from a URL using JSON-LD or Microdata parse first

Importer MUST create a Link Card instead of importing whenever: (a) domain matches denylist; (b) JSON-LD isAccessibleForFree === false; (c) response indicates paywall (e.g., 402/403 or known markers); (d) robots or site Terms prohibit scraping. Link Card persists only URL, domain and user-authored metadata; no publisher recipe text or ingredient/instruction lists are stored.

Importer shall respect robots.txt/ACAP, site Terms, and our denylist. Server-side fetches must validate isAccessibleForFree when present and abort import if false. If any policy gate fails, do not fetch or persist recipe content; create a Link Card (R060-R066).

For sources allowed by policy AND where isAccessibleForFree !== false, the importer may store normalized Recipe fields (e.g., name, image, times, ingredients, instructions, yields, author, nutrition, source_url). For denylisted/paywalled/blocked sources, persist Link Card only; never store publisher recipe content.
Library page shall display recipes as cards with image title tags and quick metadata
Users shall be able to search recipes by keyword
Users shall be able to filter recipes by tags such as Dinner Vegan Chicken
Users shall be able to mark recipes as Favorites and filter by Favorites
Recipe detail page shall show hero image tags description prep time cook time total time servings ingredients steps notes and serve-with
Serve-with entries may be plain text or links to other recipes
Cook Mode shall present one step at a time with large type and next or back controls
Cook Mode shall offer optional inline timers when a step includes a duration
Cook Mode shall attempt wake lock to prevent screen sleep where supported
Users shall be able to edit and delete their own recipes
Users shall be able to export their data in JSON or CSV format on demand
Public recipe pages shall be available for user-owned recipes only with a shareable link

Public pages shall exclude imported full text unless the user created it. For Link Cards, render only user-authored metadata. Any enrichment from remote JSON-LD must be ephemeral (client-rendered at view time) and not persisted for denylisted/paywalled sources.
Creator Mode shall support schema-based ingestion for creator sites with canonical links
Creator Mode shall offer an embeddable card that links back to the creator site
New URL imports land in a Recipe Inbox with status: Imported, LinkCard, Needs-Review. If policy gates block import, status=LinkCard with blocked_reason.
Auto-tagging suggestions shall infer cuisine, meal-type, appliance, and source brand from URL and, when allowed, from JSON-LD. For Link Cards, limit inference to URL/domain and user input.
Bulk import supports up to 50 URLs per batch; applies policy gates per URL. Disallowed URLs auto-create Link Cards; allowed URLs import Recipe records.
Importer version 2 shall support OCR for image uploads from books or screenshots
Shopping Brain version 1 shall generate a single shopping list from selected recipes
Shopping Brain version 1 shall normalize and dedupe ingredients and convert units between US and metric
Shopping Brain version 1 shall group items by aisle such as Produce Dairy Pantry
Theming shall allow multiple color themes and a dark-mode toggle
Users shall be able to create and save filtered views such as fifteen minute vegetarian dinners
Advanced shopping lists shall support multiple lists and a weekly planning view
Advanced lists shall export to PDF or CSV or Markdown
Pantry and Leftovers Lite shall allow a quick pantry list and Cook with what I have filter
Leftovers shall include a simple freshness tracker such as good until Friday
Print-to-Cookbook shall export recipes to a styled PDF and integrate with print-on-demand
Print-to-Cookbook shall include user-owned recipes only and imported recipes shall appear as link cards
Family sharing shall allow invitations to a shared cookbook including recipes and shopping lists
AI features in future may include smart substitutions summarization and pantry-based suggestions
Meal planning calendar with drag-and-drop recipes shall be available in future
Nutrition tracking shall estimate macros and calories from recipe data in future
Integrations shall include grocery APIs and smart speaker support in future
Performance budgets shall target LCP less than two point five seconds on 4G CLS less than zero point one and first input responsive
App shall provide meaningful empty states error states and skeleton loaders
Security shall include password hashing with argon2 or bcrypt input validation with Zod and strict authorization on recipe ownership
File uploads shall be size and type-checked and use signed URLs to object storage
Observability shall use Sentry for errors and PostHog for events including RecipeImported CookStarted ListCreated
PWA behavior shall support offline Cook Mode with cached assets and recipe data
Age gate set at sixteen years or older and content policy shall be documented and enforced where applicable
Public release gating shall require legal pages live and Report Abuse wired on public pages
Accessibility shall respect prefers-reduced-motion and provide visible focus states
Data model shall support recipe types owned or external with public flag tags array steps array and ingredients array
Routes shall include slash recipes for library slash recipes slash id for detail and slash cook slash id for cook mode
Public share routes shall be slash r slash slug for read-only pages

Link Card entity: persist url, domain, created_at, updated_at, user_title (optional), user_notes[], user_tags[], user_rating(1-5), made_count, last_made_at, blocked_reason enum[denylist,paywalled,robots,tos,unknown,null].
Link Card UI: visually distinct cards in library with source domain, favicon, user title, tags, rating, and quick actions (Open, Add Note, Tag, Rate, Plan, Add to List).

Link Card enrichment: when viewing a Link Card, the client MAY fetch JSON-LD to display ephemeral prep/cook time, yield, and author only if not denylisted/paywalled; never persist remote ingredient/instruction text.
Denylist file: newline-separated domains at config/denylist.txt; loader validates and exposes a check(domain)->{blocked:boolean, reason}. Server actions MUST call this before any fetch.
Importer policy gates order: 1) denylist; 2) robots/ACAP; 3) fetch head; 4) parse JSON-LD isAccessibleForFree; 5) ToS heuristics/paywall markers. First failure halts import and creates Link Card.
Notes & variants: users can attach freeform notes and structured variants (ingredient swaps, time adjustments) to Link Cards; variants are user-authored only.
Meal planning with Link Cards: allow scheduling a Link Card into the planner; shopping list is based on user-entered ingredients or notes.
Telemetry: log policy outcomes (imported vs linkcard + blocked_reason). No logging of publisher content.
Export: users can export Link Cards (CSV/JSON) containing only user-authored metadata and source URLs.
Legal affordance: Link Cards display 'From <domain>' and an 'Open Original' primary action; avoid hotlinking blocked assets; prefer favicon over hotlinked hero images for denied sources.
Users shall be able to change their password if logged in
Users shall be able to reset their password if logged out
Users shall be able to sign-out from all devices
Users shall be able to delete their account (along with all data)
When a user clicks “delete account” button there will be a popup confirming / cancelling the action first.
When a user clicks "delete recipe” button there will be a popup confirming / cancelling the action first.
